production_provider_contract_and_allowli.notes: Verify the exact production HEALTH_AI_API_URL/provider identity, HTTPS allowlist, secret rotation, signed provider agreement/DPA, data residency/retention and incident contacts.

veterinary_registry_credential_coverage.notes: Document which configured markets and veterinary credential/registry sources are actually supported. Unsupported jurisdiction/document combinations must route to manual review, never auto-verify.

confidence_calibration_and_false_decisio.notes: Validate the >0.85 auto / 0.65-0.85 manual / <0.65 reject policy on representative labelled documents and record false-accept/false-reject rates before production enablement.

manual_review_staffing_under_24h.notes: Verify staffed operational coverage, queue alerts, escalation and measured review SLA under 24 hours.

production_privacy_and_deletion_exercise.notes: Exercise provider-side deletion/retention and Tailmance account deletion/export using synthetic health documents; confirm raw OCR/provider content is not written to Tailmance telemetry.
